label: ACT composite score
definition: The ACT Composite score on the 1–36 scale, as reported by ACT for US high school graduates who took the test, counting each student's most recent score.
phrasings: what is the top 1% of ACT scores
what ACT score is top 1 percent
what is a 99th percentile ACT score
is a 34 on the ACT top 1%
how rare is a 36 on the ACT
